about_the_game:
Dive into the very essence of survival and human ingenuity with Zero Factory, a unique survival game that melds magic and technology in an open, corrupted, and ever-evolving world.

🌍 Begin your journey in the Stone Age and carve a path through the ages, advancing technologically to build massive automated factories and take on the ultimate challenge of resource creation and management.

Character Customization 🔧

In Zero Factory, every stone, every blade of grass, and every drop of water can be key to your survival. Manage your thirst and hunger, cultivate land, raise livestock, and erect shelters to protect yourself from the elements. But survival doesn't end there. Your world is alive and reactive, filled with secrets and dangers, monsters drawn by mystical catalysts that promise rewards while posing deadly risks. Your ability to defend your domain and leverage these events can make the difference between prosperity and downfall.

Explore and Help the Villagers 🏚️

Discover ancient ruins and rebuild a forgotten village to its former glory. Along the way, you’ll meet villagers who can assist you in your journey. Each NPC brings unique skills: the lumberjack will cut and store wood for you, the mechanist can boost your machines' speed, and more. Together, you can forge a thriving settlement in the skies of ZeroFactory.

Master the Machine - The Age of Automated Industry

The beating heart of Zero Factory lies in its sophisticated and evolving machinery. As you progress, you'll unlock and master an array of complex machines that turn survival into a symphony of industrial efficiency.

Basic Machine Setup ⚙️

  • Smelters: In the beginning, there was fire. Smelters are your faithful companions, transforming raw ore into pure metal, laying the foundation of your technological ascent.

  • Alloy Smelters: Modern alchemy comes to life with these advanced forges, capable of combining metals to create strong and valuable alloys, crucial for constructing your most advanced structures.

  • Containers: With greatness comes the need for increased storage. Containers allow you to store large quantities of resources, ensuring that your factories never stop due to a lack of materials.

  • Assemblers: The pinnacle of automation. These ingenious machines are the key to unlocking true automation potential, taking over the repetitiveness of handcrafting and freeing you to design and optimize your industrial empire.

  • Sawmills: Wood is an essential resource, and automated sawmills convert it into useful components for all aspects of your settlement, from buildings to tools.

  • Mining Machines: Extract the earth's riches without lifting a finger. These powerful machines dig deep, tapping into ore veins to unearth hidden treasures beneath the surface, fueling your constant progression towards innovation and industrial dominance.

Every machine in Zero Factory is a step towards greatness. Your empire will expand not just across the land but through the ages, as you transform a wild and magical world into an automated industrial landscape, a testament to human ingenuity's power. The future of your world is in your hands – and at the forefront of your mechanical genius.

Key Features

  • Donjons, Quests, and Ancient Mysteries: Embark on thrilling adventures in dungeons and complete quests to uncover the hidden history of ZeroFactory.

  • Rebuild and Thrive: Restore a forgotten village and watch as NPCs assist you in building a prosperous future.

  • Flying Machines: Craft and customize flying ships to explore, trade, and transport goods.

  • Mechanical Wings: Soar through the skies with customizable wings powered by your machines.

  • Farm Monsters for Rewards: Create mob farms to generate gold, legendary equipment, and rare artifacts.

  • Pets: Tame adorable companions like kittens to aid you in your adventures.

  • Survival and Evolution: Start with nothing and advance technologically towards a fully automated age.

  • Epic Bosses and Artifacts: Defeat colossal bosses guarding artifacts that enhance your industrial empire.

Zero Factory offers an unprecedented survival experience where every choice, every invention, and every battle shapes your destiny. Are you ready to take on the challenge?

  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / Radeon RX 5700
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10 64Bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11600K / AMD Ryzen 5 5600X
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1080 / Radeon RX 5700
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
